CP1326 updates next Meal card identity synchronously when the active deck selection changes and fences async preview completion by render generation plus meal ID. CP1329 preserves CP1325 sequential active/waiting Meal-card identity assertions and CP1328 slow-photo handoff sequencing; the latest automated run passed both swipe regressions while menu-anchor tests exposed and localized a positioning bug.
